create_KserveV2OcrModel: create a KserveV2OcrModel instance with enabled flag, options, and accelerator options for remote OCR inference
initialize_KserveV2OcrModel_client: initialize the KServe v2 client with HTTP or gRPC transport for remote document OCR
preprocess_KserveV2OcrModel_image: preprocess a PIL image into a numpy array with shape (1, H, W, C) for KServe v2 OCR inference
run_KserveV2OcrModel_call: run the KServe v2 OCR model on a batch of pages to extract text cells with bounding boxes and confidence scores
close_KserveV2OcrModel_connection: close the KServe v2 client connection and release resources
